    "Ability to customize workflows and automate CRM tasks.",

    "User-friendly interface for core functions and organization."

  "cons": [
    "Reporting tools may not be comprehensive enough for detailed analysis.",
    "Can be challenging to adapt the sales pipeline to specific company needs.",
    "The user interface can occasionally feel overwhelming despite its benefits."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Managing Partner likely found Zoho CRM to be a capable all-in-one solution for managing their small telecommunications business. They appreciated its customization options and ability to automate workflows, which streamlined operations. While the core interface was generally user-friendly, they may have encountered limitations with reporting and adapting the system to their unique sales process, leading to a moderately positive but not perfect experience."
